items.stem: Which two statements about loss aversion are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: People tend to feel losses more strongly than equivalent gains
options.rationale: Correct: this asymmetry defines loss aversion.

options.text: It can lead investors to avoid crystallising a loss
options.rationale: Correct: aversion to losses delays selling losers.

options.text: It means people enjoy losses more than gains
options.rationale: People dislike losses; they do not enjoy them.

options.text: It proves markets are always perfectly efficient
options.rationale: It is evidence of behaviour inconsistent with pure efficiency.

items.explanation: Correct: this asymmetry defines loss aversion.
